# Backend 10 full-read retention

Twelve entries and all thirty questions were read in full, including authored leads, every summary/variant, and the complete MySQL transaction supplement. Catalog-selected current entries match the preflight and saved live-base snapshots. Every string/block is mapped in retention-map.json; exact modified spans are in source-span-map.json. All question strings/order, IDs, anchors, image/link targets and entry metadata remain unchanged. Only exact ordinary lead duplicates and adjacent duplicate headings were deleted; executable promises became design/verification contracts without discarding case details.

- ch08: all SCD2 interval and two-time distinctions, guardian locking, unique current marker versus historical overlaps, first-version race, monotonic-only versus late correction, feature available_at and online/TTL/model dimensions retained. After-image versus delta, seen_fact historical conflict ledger, unseen older-version limit, signed64/±1e9 limits, SQLite transaction ownership, v1/v2 relocation/v3 tombstone examples retained. Report import sheet/row/batch/hash recovery, same publication version, FX/CTR, real-time/offline axes and migration thresholds retained.
- ch09: incident facts versus candidate causes, vessel event/source identity and late updates, independent latest/grid/push contracts, count NULL versus zero, body/object manifest, three meanings of one-primary-many-secondary retained. TaskBoard containment/order/dependency distinctions, single board guardian, RC graph check, 1000/10000 limits, same-version reverse edges, version versus idempotent receipt retained.
- ch10: non-NULL combinations, multi-NULL UNIQUE, prefix/collation, (1,NULL) twice and cross-tenant a, update and concurrency cases retained. Missing unique_null listing claim becomes a prose test protocol.
- ch13: surname versus nickname, female 王 prefix and rows 1/4/5, status=0 with strict age>12, covering versus range alternatives retained. 70–80 million background, independent hobby counting, exact count cost, optional rather than assumed tenant, signed IDs −1/0/1/2 and two-item page, N:N membership retained.
- ch14: original predicate ambiguity, AND precedence, NULL three-valued Q AND P IS NOT TRUE, stable d/id order, per-branch Top10 proof and shared snapshot retained; 9 truth-table and 200 seeded Top10 models checked locally, not a MySQL test.
- ch17: tenant/status/priority/time ordering versus time-first index, seven-day bounded range, task listing versus claim, secondary INPLACE not INSTANT, MDL/disk/replication costs and explicit rollback limits retained. All capacity arithmetic, stable versus unstable queues, 99% cache miss multiplier, S1 100000/80000/800 distribution plus 20 other tenants, 10000-row shift and unchanged status ratio retained. Detached SQL/script promises become explicit input/measurement design.
- ch18: statement versus transaction rollback, default timeout versus deadlock, commit unknown and successful-commit cleanup error, fresh-transaction retry, external effects, cashier versus channel versus ledger, same-connection RR and long-export constraints retained. Primary-key ceiling corrected: lower-ID inserts and delayed commits can appear; it is not a commit watermark. JDBC gates keep literal loopback, lab opt-in, exact versions, timeouts 5/15/10 seconds, rows 10000+1, 80.00 test total, setReadOnly hint distinction.
